name: Cerrado Gold Inc.
summary: Cerrado Gold Inc. operates as a gold mining and exploration company in Argentina and Canada. The company also explores for zinc, copper, lead, tin, silver, gold, iron, and vanadium deposits. It owns 100% interests in the Minera Don Nicolas project covering an area of approximately 333,400 hectares located in the Santa Cruz province of Argentina; and the Mont Sorcier iron and vanadium project covering an area of approximately 1,919 hectares located near Chibougamau, Quebec in Canada. The company also holds an interest in the Lagoa Salgada volcanogenic sulphide project, focused on polymetallic resources. Cerrado Gold Inc. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
